text.description_html:
Kwikset PVLRCT Rectangular Rose Prava Door Levers

The Kwikset Prava door lever with rectangular roses have a contemporary design with a knurled lever making it an excellent choice for those who like a more modern look. The rectangular rose Prava lever set is easy to install. Fits most pre-drilled doors since it has an adjustable backset for 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches for door 1-3/8 inches up to 1-3/4 inches thick. Available in dummy, passage, privacy and key entry functions.

Features of the Kwikset Rectangular Rose Prava Door Lever Set:

  • Fits most pre-drilled doors.
  • Anti-pick SmartKey system (on Keyed Entry function).
  • Non-handed levers.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.
  • Manufacture Lifetime Mechanical & Finish Warranty.

Specifications of the Kwikset Rectangular Rose Prava Door Lever:

  • Lever Length: 4-1/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Rose Width: 2-25/32"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: Adjustable 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: An inactive lever for use as a pull or to match trim. This non-operational lever is for one side of the door. Complete Set - 1 lever and 1 rose.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch and strike plate.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Pushbutton on interior rose engages privacy lock on both levers; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch and strike plate.
  • Keyed Entry: Use when a keyed lock is needed. An ANSI/BHMA A156.2 Grade 2 security lock that is operated by a key from the exterior and a turnbutton on the lever from the interior. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, 2 keys, door latch and strike plate.
